title: VPN Types: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: There are two main kinds of V P N. One connects whole offices together. The other connects one person to the office.

scenes.heading: Mailroom vs personal courier
scenes.narration: Think of the company mailroom and the personal courier. A site to site V P N is the mailroom, moving all mail between offices. A remote access V P N is a personal courier for one worker. Site to site normally uses I P sec, with I K E on U D P five hundred. Remote access can use I P sec or S S L.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. Remote access can use S S L too. Site to site needs no client software. Phase one makes the management tunnel.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva VPN types lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Site to site joins offices, and remote access joins people. I K E has two phases. Remote access can use S S L. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva VPN types lab.
